Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. We are narrowing down vendors for a limited pilot and need an updated view of Redwood's subprocessor roster (with country-level data flow mapping) and any DPA addenda that cover temporary caching/edge partners. Security asked for the following by EOD Friday:

- A current inventory of subprocessors touching any request/telemetry logs or cached content (vendor name, function, country of processing).
- For each vendor, the data residency footprint (US/EU/APAC) and whether data-at-rest is encrypted with a KMS/HSM.
- Any planned subprocessor changes in the next 60 days (and fallback plan).
- Copy or link to the DPA addendum we would sign for pilot scopes + any escrow/KMS attestation for onshore fallback.

I've attached our inventory template — if you can populate it and return, that will be perfect. If there's an internal point of contact we should expect to see evidence from (SOC 2 snapshot, KMS attestation), please flag them.

We'd also like to schedule a 30-minute call with security + procurement next week to review. Availability: Mon/Tue mornings ET.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — our procurement timeline is tight.

Best,
Aisha Patel
Manager, Vendor Risk
FinServe Inc.
